cues.en: It created a sense of continuity that's largely absent, or at best a tertiary consideration on YouTube

cues.zh: 尽管 YouTube 如今已是一些规模化业务的底层平台
cues.en: Despite the fact that YouTube is now the underpinning platform for some full-size businesses

cues.zh: YouTube 的结构在处理任何多用户场景时仍然很糟，
cues.en: YouTube's structure is still awful at handling any sort of multi-user setup,

cues.zh: 更别提从个人频道妥善过渡到由团队管理的专业频道了
cues.en: let alone properly transitioning from a personal channel to a professional one managed by a team

cues.zh: 如果你的频道绑定的是个人 Google 账号，比如说你的邮箱
cues.en: If your channel is attached to a personal Google account, including say, your email

cues.zh: 那么让别人访问频道后台的唯一方式，就是让他们访问整个账号
cues.en: the only way to give someone access to the back-end of the channel is to give them access to the entire account

cues.zh: 此外，权限无法在团队成员之间拆分
cues.en: Additionally, powers cannot be partitioned between team members

cues.zh: 任何能访问该频道的人，都拥有上传、下载、删除、重命名、审核一切内容的完整权限
cues.en: Anyone with access to the channel enjoys full access to upload, download, delete, rename, moderate everything

cues.zh: 这带来了严重的安全隐患：只要攻破团队中任何一个人，就等于攻破了一切
cues.en: This creates significant security concerns as compromising any individual member of the team compromises everything

cues.zh: YouTube 的播放列表系统能用，但远谈不上优雅
cues.en: YouTube's Playlist system is functional but hardly elegant

cues.zh: 而网站的整体结构让内容创作者很难
cues.en: and the overall structure of the site as a whole makes it troublesome for content creators

cues.zh: 在不分割观众群的前提下有效隔离内容
cues.en: to effectively compartmentalize content without segmenting their viewership

cues.zh: 为特定类型内容开一个副频道，实际上就是从零开始，还得把它当作独立实体来维护
cues.en: A secondary channel for specific types of content is effectively starting from scratch and needs to be maintained as its own entity

cues.zh: 此外，频道管理者无法有效地把内容从一个频道迁移到另一个频道
cues.en: Additionally there's no way for channel managers to effectively migrate content from one channel to another

cues.zh: 除非从头重新上传，而这要求所有附属数据
cues.en: without going through the process of reuploading from scratch, requiring that all secondary data

cues.zh: 从名称到描述，再到字幕、副标题和缩略图，都得手动重新录入
cues.en: from names to descriptions to captions and subtitles and thumbnails be re-entered, manually

cues.zh: 哦对了，迁移过程中还会丢失现有的评论、观看量、投票等等
cues.en: Oh, and you lose existing comments, views, votes, and so on in the move

cues.zh: 这些只是 YouTube 网站结构设计问题中的一小部分
cues.en: These are just a few of these structural site design issues with YouTube

cues.zh: 更不用说缺乏审核带来的文化问题了
cues.en: not even addressing the cultural problems with a lack of moderation

cues.zh: 社区标准含糊不清、执行不一，以及自动化系统容易被利用
cues.en: unclear and unevenly enforced community standards and easily exploited automated systems

cues.zh: YouTube 有大量缺陷，而所有这些都可以成为竞争对手的核心卖点
cues.en: There are a wealth of deficiencies with YouTube that could all be centered as a core selling point for a competitor

cues.zh: 说回这一点，我之前提到过
cues.en: To bring this back around I mentioned this

cues.zh: 但我认为，你们已经雇人做研发了
cues.en: but it's my belief that you already employ people to do research and development

cues.zh: 甚至在开始搭建平台之前，就做过一些市场调研
cues.en: and did some market research before you even started building your platform

cues.zh: 在我看来，这只是一个合理的商业决策
cues.en: To me that seems like just a sensible business decision

cues.zh: 你需要了解你的竞争对手，
cues.en: You need to know your competitors,

cues.zh: 你需要了解你的用户，也需要了解市场
cues.en: you need to know your users, and you need to know the market

cues.zh: 如果你没有这些，那……
cues.en: If you don't have that, well...

cues.zh: 这实在没法让我放心
cues.en: it doesn't exactly fill me with confidence

cues.zh: 如果你确实有这些，而这就是你选择上线的网站
cues.en: If you do have that and this is the site that you chose to launch

cues.zh: 这些就是你认为至关重要的功能，是你认为能吸引目标受众的功能
cues.en: These are the features that you considered vital, that you figured would capture the audience that you're looking for

cues.zh: 那这实在没法让我放心
cues.en: Well, it doesn't exactly fill me with confidence

cues.zh: 简单说，如果有人在 Twitter 上吐槽你的网站
cues.en: Put simply, if someone's roasting your site on Twitter

cues.zh: 你的联合创始人就不该在 Twitter 上恳求他们提交反馈、让网站变得更好
cues.en: your co-founder shouldn't be imploring them on Twitter to submit feedback and make the site better

cues.zh: 因为你应该早就知道
cues.en: because you should already know

cues.zh: 如果你没做过调研，
cues.en: If you haven't done your research,

cues.zh: 如果你没把安全、审核和协作系统融入网站的核心基础设施
cues.en: if you haven't worked systems for security, moderation, and collaboration into the core infrastructure of the site

cues.zh: 如果这些功能不是你设计的基础，那已经太晚了
cues.en: if those features aren't foundational to your design, then it's already too late

cues.zh: 这意味着你并没有打造出一个 YouTube 的竞争对手
cues.en: It means that you haven't built a YouTube competitor

cues.zh: 你只是做了一个 YouTube 克隆，而且注定会重蹈覆辙
cues.en: You've just built a YouTube clone, and you're dooming yourself to the same mistakes

cues.zh: 一个由七拼八凑的功能拼成、却无法正确集成的弗兰肯斯坦式产品
cues.en: A frankenstein product built of cobbled-together features that don't properly integrate

cues.zh: 善意的解读是，你只是没准备好，这本身就不太体面；但更糟的解读是
cues.en: The charitable reading is that you're just unprepared which isn't a good look on its own, but the worse reading

cues.zh: 你们是骗子、寻租者，想利用内容创作者的希望和劳动
cues.en: is that you're grifters, rent seekers, looking to exploit the hopes and labor of content creators

cues.zh: 而互联网上已经到处都是这种人
cues.en: and the internet is already full of those
